scope: Standalone 3D PhysicsRuntime terminal-failure isolation; source correctness only.
reviewed: Terminal flag is set after retryable dt validation and before any solver advancement; cleared only after all scene state, event cloning/sorting and overlap publication succeeds. Error returns and caught unwinds leave it set.

Failed state(), state_iter(), states() and events() expose no prior/partial frame; guards precede ID lookup/clone. Existing raycast, character-query and sync_motion guards retain typed NumericRange refusal.
Void sync/install/remove cannot alter or revive a failed runtime. clear_character_query_frame only invalidates an auxiliary query cache and cannot expose/revive the failed world.
Late-scene regression has a successful previous trigger frame, then crosses supported position range after an earlier scene advanced; assertions cover hidden state/events and permanent failure.
Caller-provided ID clone panic induces an actual unwind after stepping, without production failure hooks. Healthy invalid-dt control preserves observations and can resume.
Scope does not assert transactional structural synchronization or general panic safety before step; no vendor, restore or save admission change.
limits: No reviewer builds or tests; root baseline red/default green and later mode qualification are separate execution evidence.
Terminal isolation hides and refuses partially advanced state rather than rolling a solver back.
